message.content: {"draft":"Fuse RMSNorm into one pass: load row once, accumulate sum-of-squares in FP32, compute rstd, then normalize, cast to input dtype, multiply by weight, and store. Use a single BLOCK_SIZE loop to avoid double memory traffic. Keep the intermediate cast before weight multiplication.","plan":"1) Allocate contiguous output. 2) Launch one kernel per row. 3) In kernel, load row in one block (BLOCK_SIZE = next_pow2(width), capped at 4096). 4) Compute sum_sq in FP32, rstd = 1/sqrt(mean+eps). 5) Normalize, cast to input dtype, multiply by weight, store. 6) Return output.","code_lines":["import torch","import triton","import triton.language as tl","","","@triton.jit","def _rmsnorm_kernel(","    X,","    Y,","    W,","    stride,","    N,","    eps,","    BLOCK_SIZE: tl.constexpr,","    IS_BF16: tl.constexpr,","):", "    row = tl.program_id(0)","    X += row * stride","    Y += row * stride","","    cols = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE)","    mask = cols < N","    x = tl.load(X + cols, mask=mask, other=0.).to(tl.float32)","","    sum_sq = tl.sum(x * x, axis=0)","    mean_sq = sum_sq / N","    rstd = 1.0 / tl.sqrt(mean_sq + eps)","","    x_hat = x * rstd","    if IS_BF16:","        x_hat = x_hat.to(tl.bfloat16)","    else:","        x_hat = x_hat.to(tl.float32)","","    w = tl.load(W + cols, mask=mask)","    y = w * x_hat","    tl.store(Y + cols, y, mask=mask)","","","def run(x, weight):","    rows, width = x.shape","    out = torch.empty_like(x)","","    BLOCK_SIZE = triton.next_power_of_2(width)","    if BLOCK_SIZE > 4096:","        BLOCK_SIZE = 4096","","    is_bf16 = 1 if x.dtype == torch.bfloat16 else 0","","    grid = (rows,)","    _rmsnorm_kernel[grid](","        x,","        out,","        weight,","        width,","        width,","        1e-6,","        BLOCK_SIZE=BLOCK_SIZE,","        IS_BF16=is_bf16,","    )","    return out"]}
